title: decision provider health
description: GET /v1/fleet/decision-providers/{id}/health[?force=1] (SRV-851): each endpoint's probe (/readyz and /v1/models, cached 10 s; a hook: its state and breaker), its breaker and its questions; status ok, failing (a breaker not closed or the last call within a minute failed), down (a probe failed) or off
